comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals this sequence is most similar (30.77%) to Myxinidin Chemical modification: a lactone is formed from the C-terminal carboxylic group to the hydroxyl group of a 3-hydroxylated C18 fatty acid. Activity: active against Gram+ S. aureus MTCC1430, B. subtilis MTCC121 5 out of 7 strains, M. luteus MTCC106, and fungus A. terreus Lab isolate.
title: Characterization of two antimicrobial peptides produced by a halotolerant Bacillus subtilis strain SK.DU.4 isolated from a rhizosphere soil sample.
